heading: The rules, in plain words
lead: Every page starts with a short version that anyone aged 13 and up can follow. The full legal text sits under each part. If the two ever seem to disagree, ask us.

terms.name: Terms
terms.intro: The agreement between you and {{productName}}. Read the short version in each box. The full text sits under it, as a draft a Romanian lawyer reviews before launch.

privacy.name: Privacy notice
privacy.intro: What we collect about you, why we need it and what you can do about it.

guidelines.name: Community guidelines
guidelines.intro: How we treat each other here. They apply to stories, comments, forums and private messages.

contact.name: Contact and company details
contact.intro: How to reach us: for users, for authorities and for removal orders, and who runs {{productName}}.

accessibility.name: Accessibility statement
accessibility.intro: How {{productName}} meets WCAG 2.2 AA, what doesn’t work yet and how to tell us about a barrier.

status.label: Document status
status.draft: Draft: a Romanian lawyer reviews this before launch

translationDraft: The Romanian translation is a draft and hasn’t been checked by a lawyer.
fallbackLanguage: This text isn’t available in your language yet, so it is shown in English.
fullTextDraft: Full text · draft for lawyer review

afterTheTest.label: After the invited test
afterTheTest.explanation: Parts marked “After the invited test” describe things that start only after the invited test. The test is for invited adults, so the age check, a parent’s or guardian’s consent and some features aren’t switched on yet.

history.heading: Version history
history.note: Every version stays here, in Romanian and English. You can also find these pages at sign-up and in Settings.

loadFailed.title: We couldn’t load this page
loadFailed.body: Check your connection and try again.

notFound.title: There’s no document at this address
notFound.body: Choose one of the documents above.

update.body: Read the new version and accept it before you post again. You can keep reading meanwhile.
update.failed: That didn’t work. Check your connection and try again.

contactUs.text: Have a question or a problem with your account?

reportForm.text: Want to report illegal content? Anyone can use the report form.

country.heading: Your country: {{place}}
country.joinFrom: In {{place}} you can join from age {{age}}.
country.consentBelow: Below {{age}}, a parent or guardian has to agree first.
country.noConsent: No parent or guardian has to agree once you can join.
country.blockedBelow: Below {{age}}, sign-up isn’t possible there, even with a parent’s or guardian’s agreement.
country.toVerify: A lawyer is still checking this rule.
country.agesIntro: The age to join and the age below which a parent or guardian has to agree, wherever you live. A region with its own law has its own row. Any country not listed follows the strictest rule.
